dimensions.issue_validity: Thorough, owner-filed bug report documenting 10 real Windows-specific bugs in line-loop subprocess orchestration.
dimensions.actionability: Highly actionable. Most original bugs (C1-C3, M1, M3) already upstreamed in core/line_loop/platform.py. Remaining gap: unguarded process.wait() on normal-exit path in phase.py.
dimensions.project_relevance: Directly relevant to core line-loop execution on Windows.
dimensions.priority_signal: Medium-high. Windows is a supported platform and most fixes are landed, but one gap remains.
dimensions.proposed_direction: Keep open as tracking ticket. Add timeout guard to process.wait() in phase.py normal-exit path. Verify all 10 patches covered before v0.21.0.

rationale: Well-documented bug report with most fixes already upstreamed. One remaining gap (unguarded process.wait) needs attention before v0.21.0. Worth keeping open as tracking ticket.
